description: Any constitutionally or isotopically distinct atom, molecule, ion, ion pair, radical, radical ion, complex, conformer etc., identifiable as a separately distinguishable entity.
terms.label: molecular entity

description: A chemical entity is a physical entity of interest in chemistry including molecular entities, parts thereof, and chemical substances.
terms.label: chemical entity

description: Hydroxides are chemical compounds containing a hydroxy group or salts containing hydroxide (OH<small><sup>−</small></sup>).
terms.label: hydroxides

description: A compound which contains oxygen, at least one other element, and at least one hydrogen bound to oxygen, and which produces a conjugate base by loss of positive hydrogen ion(s) (hydrons).
terms.label: oxoacid

description: Any polyatomic entity that is an electrically neutral entity consisting of more than one atom.
terms.label: molecule

description: An oxoacid containing a single carboxy group.
terms.label: monocarboxylic acid

description: An organophosphorus compound is formally a compound containing at least one carbon-phosphorus bond, but the term is often extended to include esters and thioesters.
terms.label: organophosphorus compound

description: Salts and esters of phosphoric and oligophosphoric acids and their chalcogen analogues. In inorganic chemistry, the term is also used to describe anionic coordination entities with phosphorus as central atom.
terms.label: phosphate

description: A heteroorganic entity is an organic molecular entity in which carbon atoms or organic groups are bonded directly to one or more heteroatoms.
terms.label: heteroorganic entity

description: A p-block molecular entity containing any pnictogen.
terms.label: pnictogen molecular entity

description: Any p-block molecular entity containing a chalcogen.
terms.label: chalcogen molecular entity

description: A carbon oxoacid acid carrying at least one ‒C(=O)OH group and having the structure RC(=O)OH, where R is any any monovalent functional group. Carboxylic acids are the most common type of organic acid.
terms.label: carboxylic acid

description: A molecular entity containing one or more atoms from any of groups 1, 2, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, and 18 of the periodic table.
terms.label: main group molecular entity

description: An s-block molecular entity is a molecular entity containing one or more atoms of an s-block element.
terms.label: s-block molecular entity

description: A main group molecular entity that contains one or more atoms of a p-block element.
terms.label: p-block molecular entity

description: A compound formally derived from an oxoacid RkE(=O)l(OH)m (l > 0) and an alcohol, phenol, heteroarenol, or enol by linking with formal loss of water from an acidic hydroxy group of the former and a hydroxy group of the latter.
terms.label: ester

description: Any molecular entity consisting of more than one atom.
terms.label: polyatomic entity

description: Any compound containing the carbonyl group, C=O. The term is commonly used in the restricted sense of aldehydes and ketones, although it actually includes carboxylic acids and derivatives.
terms.label: carbonyl compound

description: Organic compounds containing an oxygen atom, =O, doubly bonded to carbon or another element.
terms.label: organic oxo compound

description: An organochalcogen compound is a compound containing at least one carbon-chalcogen bond.
terms.label: organochalcogen compound

description: An organochalcogen compound containing at least one carbon-oxygen bond.
terms.label: organooxygen compound

description: A molecular entity consisting of two or more chemical elements.
terms.label: heteroatomic molecular entity

description: Any molecular entity that contains carbon.
terms.label: organic molecular entity

description: Any organic molecular entity that is acidic and contains carbon in covalent linkage.
terms.label: organic acid

description: Any molecule that consists of at least one carbon atom as part of the electrically neutral entity.
terms.label: organic molecule
